audit.whatIsWrong: Garen wins 46.9% over 4002 games, yet the chart hands Garen 6 of 7 stages and the rating fields call it 'Favoured matchup — difficulty 4/10, Kayle carry threat 5/10' while diff is already 'HARD'.
audit.why: A losing win rate against a hypercarry cannot be a 4/10 favoured lane. The chart has to concede the item stages.
audit.corrected: Flipped First item to Kayle (win[5], phases[5].side/rating/why together) and set diffRating 6/10, carryRating 9/10, plus the two difficulty summary strings.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[5].t gives Divine Judgment a 100s cooldown.
audit.why: Divine Judgment is 160/120/80s. At rank 1 it is a whole wave of downtime — that is the single biggest all-in window in the lane and the old number understates it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three fields attribute the slow to Kayle's E ('her E slow kiting', 'no escape besides E slow-poke', 'Kite with E slow').
audit.why: The slow is Radiant Blast (Q), a 900-range piercing sword that also shreds resistances, 12/11/10/9/8s. Starfire Spellblade (E) is an auto-attack reset dealing missing-health damage — no slow at all. Decisive Strike breaks all slows affecting Garen, so Q purges Radiant Blast outright; and the E wind-up, not a cast, is the tell that her burst is coming.
audit.corrected: Rewrote spikes[0].text, spikes[1].text, wants.you[1] and wants.foe[1] with the real names and the purge interaction.

audit.why: report[8].t already buys Executioner's Calling first back and prioritises Mortal Reminder against Celestial Blessing's 15s heal, which is what the needs-antiheal flag asks for.
